fusions.name: Warning Spray
fusions.desc: Sprays a cone that deals 10 damage to everything caught in it, knocks it back 2 tiles and leaves it [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Tainted Bite
fusions.desc: Bites for 4 damage and makes the target [Poisoned] for 1 damage a second for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Think Twice
fusions.desc: For 8 seconds, each debuff laid on you has a 50% chance to be sent back to its source instead.

fusions.name: Parting Musk
fusions.desc: When a non-fire blow hurts you, a spray hits the nearest enemy within 4 tiles for 6 damage and leaves it [Poisoned] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
